decision.name: Ransomware encryption: two shapes of one process tree
decision.reasoning: Ransomware encryption (ATT&CK T1486): ciphertext-like content (4 of 4 copies under .crypt whose originals are gone high-entropy with no format header); renames to a new extension (encrypted copies under a new extension (.crypt) beside the originals deleted, e.g. @ROOT@/home/u/docs/f00.pdf.crypt); deletion of originals after writing new files (20 files of 4 KiB or more deleted in 60 s after 20 new files were written, last @ROOT@/home/u/docs/f00.pdf) by /home/u/.local/bin/nn-ms-cpdel (pid 5300003, writer pid 5300003; no package installed it). Two shapes of one actor within 120 s: kill its process tree [held back: the kill of the ransomware actor's process tree (NN-L-IMP-001, lab PR 225) — alert only, by default, until the signed per-rule response policy enables it]
